blocks.text: The Filipino musical drama UNFILTERED held its premiere screening on November 8, 2026, at TriNoma in Quezon City, bringing together cast members, the production team, guests, and mental health advocates. Through relatable characters, original music, and stories that reflected young people’s experiences, the film sought to make conversations about mental health more accessible to Filipino youth. “We need to find creative ways to reach young people. Music and storytelling allow us to speak their language and connect with them emotionally,” said Jenie Chan, executive director of I.Syoot Multimedia Production Company and creator of UNFILTERED.
